quizName: DMV Practice Test #2 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?

options.text: A leather jacket
Boots that cover the ankle
A baseball cap that fits snugly
Gloves

questions.correctAnswerText: A baseball cap that fits snugly
questions.explanation: Wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?

options.text: Dry pavement
Gravel
Snow
Leaves

questions.correctAnswerText: Dry pavement
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted markings, and metal plates all reduce traction. Dry pavement provides the best traction.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet:

options.text: Limits your side vision.
Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
Is usually uncomfortable.
Makes it harder to control your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
questions.explanation: A helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet does not limit your side vision.

questions.question: When riding on a bridge grating, you should:

options.text: Always ride on the far right side of the lane.
Always ride on the far left side of the lane.
Slowly zigzag across the grating.
Relax, maintain a steady speed, and ride straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Relax, maintain a steady speed, and ride straight.
questions.explanation: Bridge gratings may cause your motorcycle to weave slightly. This is normal and safe. Simply relax and maintain a steady speed. Zigzagging to compensate is dangerous.

questions.question: Signals on a motorcycle:

options.text: Are not very important.
Are more important than signals on larger vehicles.
Should only be used when another vehicle is right next to you.
Are less important than signals on larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are more important than signals on larger vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcyclists are more vulnerable than car drivers. Using signals properly is even more important for motorcycle riders.

questions.question: Under normal conditions, maintain a minimum ______ following distance.

options.text: One-second
Two-second
Three-second
Four-second

questions.correctAnswerText: Two-second
questions.explanation: Keep at least a two-second following distance in normal conditions. Increase this distance when conditions are poor.

questions.question: Riding gloves should:

options.text: Not be worn because they make your hands too hot.
Be worn to get a better grip on the handgrips.
Not be worn because they make controls harder to work.
Be worn only on cooler days.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be worn to get a better grip on the handgrips.
questions.explanation: Wear durable leather gloves. They improve your grip on the handgrips and protect your hands in a crash.

questions.question: Mirror checks:

options.text: Are unimportant.
Should only be done on long trips.
Should be part of your normal scanning routine.
Are not helpful since you can't change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be part of your normal scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your regular scanning. Always use mirrors before changing lanes, stopping at intersections, or slowing down.

questions.question: A way to lower your crash risk is to:

options.text: Tell other road users what you plan to do.
Not look ahead while riding.
Wear dark clothes.
Ride in spots that make you hard to see.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell other road users what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Stay visible to others by using your signals, brake light, and proper lane position. Keep space around your motorcycle and always scan ahead, behind, and beside your vehicle.

questions.question: When riding in traffic, remember that motorcycles:

options.text: Are too small to have blind spots.
Have blind spots too small to cause problems.
Have blind spots that require head checks.
Have only one blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have blind spots that require head checks.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like any other vehicle. Always turn your head to check for traffic before changing lanes.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle on a slippery surface, what should you do?

options.text: Ride faster than usual.
Use only the front brake.
Slow down.
Use only the rear brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, slow down. Use both brakes when braking. Avoid sudden movements.

questions.question: How should a motorcyclist position themselves in a lane?

options.text: Stay in the same spot in the lane all the time.
Move around constantly to keep other drivers out of the lane.
Change position based on road and traffic conditions.
Do not worry about lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change position based on road and traffic conditions.
questions.explanation: There is no single best lane position. Adjust your position as road and traffic conditions change.

questions.question: What should motorcycle riders know about clothing?

options.text: It should be loose enough to flap in the wind.
It should not cover your arms or legs completely.
Do not wear a jacket if the weather is warm.
Good clothing can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: Good clothing can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: Proper clothing gives you important protection in a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly but still allow you to move freely.

questions.question: What is an advantage of smoothly downshifting on a motorcycle?

options.text: It serves no purpose.
It lets the engine help slow the motorcycle.
It is required by law.
It should not be done around other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lets the engine help slow the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Downshifting smoothly allows the engine to help slow the motorcycle. If you use engine braking, activate your brake lights separately so other drivers know you are slowing down.

questions.question: What is true about riding a motorcycle at night?

options.text: It is easier because you can see the lights of other vehicles better.
It is harder because you cannot see as well.
It is not allowed on highways.
It is less distracting than riding during the day.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is harder because you cannot see as well.
questions.explanation: Night riding is more difficult because visibility is reduced. Without natural light and shadows, it is harder to judge distances and see clearly.

questions.question: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. What should you do?

options.text: Do not ride during the day.
Wear bright clothing at all times.
Ride on the shoulder to stay out of traffic.
Wear dark clothing at all times.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright clothing at all times.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes occur during daylight hours. Always wear bright colors when riding to be seen clearly, even during the day.

questions.question: How does riding with a passenger affect a motorcycle?

options.text: It usually makes no difference in how the motorcycle handles.
It is usually safe for new riders.
It changes how the motorcycle handles.
It helps new riders get used to different situations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It changes how the motorcycle handles.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to the motorcycle, which changes how it handles. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: Your friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle. What should you do?

options.text: Let them ride.
Tell them to use roads with less traffic.
Stay out of it.
Take their keys.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take their keys.
questions.explanation: Never let someone ride if they have been drinking. Do whatever you can to stop them, including taking their keys. Find another way for them to get home.

questions.question: What type of road sign is rectangular in shape?

options.text: School crossing sign.
Railroad crossing sign.
Stop sign.
Speed limit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed limit sign.
questions.explanation: Rectangular signs with white background and black text or symbols tell drivers about road rules, like speed limits. You must follow all rules shown on these signs.

questions.question: What is the correct body position on a motorcycle?

options.text: Sit forward enough that your arms are slightly bent when holding the grips.
Sit as far back as possible and reach forward to hold the grips.
Lean forward over the bike so your arms support your weight.
Keep your knees far away from the gas tank.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sit forward enough that your arms are slightly bent when holding the grips.
questions.explanation: Sit forward so your arms bend slightly when holding the grips. This lets you reach and control all the controls easily and comfortably.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?

options.text: Wear a helmet.
Wear a leather jacket.
Use only the rear brake.
Wear goggles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a helmet.
questions.explanation: A good helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. It is your best protection if you have an accident.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Ride faster than usual.
Ride more slowly than usual.
Start slowing later than usual.
Try to fit into small gaps in traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride more slowly than usual.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight to your motorcycle. This means it will speed up slower, turn slower, and need more distance to stop. Ride slower, start braking earlier, keep more space between you and other vehicles, and wait for larger gaps in traffic.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle rider improve their visibility?

options.text: Wear dark-colored clothing.
Turn off the headlight.
Follow another vehicle very closely.
Wear bright-colored clothing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright-colored clothing.
questions.explanation: To be seen by other drivers, wear bright colors with reflective material. Also use your headlight at all times and use your signals and brake light correctly.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black letters or symbols?

options.text: Warning
Service
Regulatory
Speed limit

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. They tell you about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What is true about a leather jacket?

options.text: It makes a rider look cool.
It is usually too warm to wear while riding.
It protects you in a crash.
It should not be worn while riding.

questions.correctAnswerText: It protects you in a crash.
questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved jacket, preferably leather, when riding. Leather jackets can help protect you in hot weather by reducing dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool even in heat.
